name: Moon Blade
description: A compact elven blade of recovered Elarith carried alongside the longer Greenshield-pattern sword for close-line work and dense-terrain engagements. Forged to feywrought standards and balanced for the cut-and-thrust technique Greenshield doctrine emphasizes at shorter reach. The name reflects the pale sheen the Elarith takes under moonlight — a property of the metal itself, not an enchantment.
narrative_effects: Supports disciplined cutting and thrusting in close melee with elven Greenshield balance.
Edge endurance is unusual: Elarith holds geometry across long service that ordinary steel does not match.
Rare in realm-side hands; the metal itself, recognized by anyone trained in elven smithcraft, raises serious questions about how it left the Feywood.
